official_event_surface.chunk_load: ClientChunkEvents.CHUNK_LOAD; callback occurs after the chunk is present
official_event_surface.chunk_unload: ClientChunkEvents.CHUNK_UNLOAD; callback occurs while the chunk is still present
official_event_surface.client_block_change_event: not present in Fabric lifecycle events v1

native_block_hook.reason: covers successful client-side state mutations without treating failed writes as geometry changes

adapter.block_rule: mark only when the changed cell intersects an active exact coverage
adapter.chunk_rule: mark only the intersection of the chunk xz footprint and each active coverage including its bounded y range
adapter.world_rule: replace tracker identity and clear active coverages
adapter.worker_rule: workers receive immutable snapshots and tokens; they never read ClientLevel
adapter.audio_rule: adapter has no audio, OpenAL, PCM or renderer dependency

scheduler.flow: client tick planner -> active coverage -> coverage cache -> immutable scene snapshot -> latest-generation worker
scheduler.result_policy: poll telemetry only; no early result is applied to audio or renderer state
